description: This file defines a PHP function 'additionalDetailsOpportunity' used to generate detailed tooltip or overlay content for opportunity records in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It constructs an informational string based on various fields of an opportunity, such as lead source, probability, next step, type, and description, for display purposes.

methods.name: additionalDetailsOpportunity
methods.description: Generates an associative array with details formatted as HTML string for display as a tooltip or overlay in a CRM UI.
